feda5e6cc81a.title: Glyn Morton obituary
feda5e6cc81a.summary:
My grandfather Glyn Morton, who has died aged 86, was an environmental microbiologist based for most of his career at the University of Lancashire, rising from senior lecturer to professor and then head of department. In 2007 he was appointed emeritus professor.

dc0569b5aa51.title: How to safely watch the solar eclipse
